clips.title: The story
paras: The Razormane Grounds form the forward encampment of the Razormane quilboar pushing eastward from the Barrens into central Durotar. Choked with sharp briars and the stripped carcasses of wild game, this bristling outpost serves as the frontline in the quilboars' unending clash with the orcs of Orgrimmar.

Sprawling beneath the red cliffs of central Durotar, the Razormane Grounds mark the furthest eastern reach of quilboar expansion out of the Barrens. Entangled within thick brambles and surrounded by bleached bones, the encampment poses a constant danger to travelers along the Southfury River. The camp is led by figures such as Captain Flat Tusk of the Battleguard and Geolord Mottle, who orchestrate raids against neighboring orc settlements and passing supply lines. Despite regular patrols dispatched from Razor Hill and nearby outposts, the Razormane replenish their ranks tirelessly, sprouting from the briars faster than the Horde can clear them.
